summary: @ornikar/renovate-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package advertises itself as a shared Renovate JSON configuration but ships an obfuscated preinstall launcher (setup.mjs, obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers and rotated string dictionary) that detects the installer's platform/arch, downloads a platform-specific Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling 727KB Bun-CJS bundle math_init.js. math_init.js is itself heavily obfuscated (rotated ~1000-entry constant array, mangled identifiers, `with` blocks preventing standard AST parsing) and executes only under the downloaded Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. A Renovate JSON config package has no functional need for a second-language runtime or a 727KB opaque executable bundle at install. The preinstall hook fires automatically on `npm install`, and the actual code that runs on the installer's machine is attacker-controlled and opaque.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
